D1 MODEL Unit: Pattern Models

Find the missing number in Figure 2, if the same mathematical model connects the vertex numbers to the center number in all three figures.

Observe that each outer vertex value (49, 16, 81; 64, 121, 25; 81, 36, 9) is a perfect square.

Formulate a model relating the square roots of the three vertex numbers to the central value.

Show Complete Solution

1. Fig 1: √49 + √16 + √81 = 7 + 4 + 9 = 20.

2. Fig 3: √81 + √36 + √9 = 9 + 6 + 3 = 18.

3. Model: Center = sum of square roots of vertices.

4. Fig 2: √64 + √121 + √25 = 8 + 11 + 5 = 24 (Option A).
